positions.name: OwnedVsRentedIntelligence
positions.frame: what distinguishes intelligence you own from intelligence you rent, and where does the durable value reside?
positions.why: Both expressions perform the same categorical distinction — owned versus rented intelligence — through a shared aphoristic register, market-pricing relational frame, and principle-level conviction. src-2 draws the constitutive distinction flatly; src-3 locates the retained value in perspective against a commodified substrate. The directional reads converge across affect, register, relational, power, value, style, and conviction dimensions — one coherent thesis performed the same way.
